## ILmdbEnvOptions interface

Options accepted by [LmdbEnv](./lmdb.lmdbenv.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ILmdbEnvOptions 
```

## Remarks

Mirrors the underlying `lmdb` `open()` options with sensible defaults tuned for the collection use case.
